title: Shared remembered cell membership, direct binding mutations and lazy spatial plans

environment.note: Development services and other user workloads may be active. No CPU affinity or host isolation.

method.aggregation: Median of three per-run statistics; not pooled percentiles
method.snapshotTiming: Official nengi-buffers writer, counting transport and controlled clock. Instance.step excludes application mutation and spatial index updates.
method.bindingTiming: 10,000 one-component roots, no subscribers/serialization. Mutation reported separately from mutation plus spatial pending-write flush and step cleanup. Spatial writes remain in one cell.
method.snapshotGc: Node PerformanceObserver during measured mutation/index/step loop, excluding forced warmup GC and result summarization
method.bindingGc: Node PerformanceObserver during measured mutation/flush/cleanup loop and result summarization, excluding forced warmup GC
method.memory: Heap after warmup vs before construction, both after explicit GC: retained memory, not cumulative allocations
method.order: Fresh sequential processes alternating variants by case and repeat; binding matrix after snapshot matrix
method.limits: Other development services may run on the host; no affinity or host isolation. No live sockets, clients or renderer in timed runs. Small differences uncertain.

source.description: Before retains all earlier pending performance changes. Same snapshot and new binding harness in both variants. Instrumented sources used only for probes.

probes.boundary: Construction-site counts and distinct returned array identities are not total allocated bytes
probes.validation: All 80 general, eight membership and 15 binding cases have identical packet and decoded-state hashes before/after; instrumented general probes also match.
